title: Bound on unfolding root sizes
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs in which each gate has distinct arguments, every NOT gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. Suppose also that every vertex with index at least $n$ is an argument of at most one gate. For every $k$ with $k\leq$ the number of gates, the sum of the unfolded sizes over the vertices in $[n,n+k)$ that have fanout zero among the first $k$ gates is at most $3k$.
